thread:
lena-partnerships: PartnerCorp marketplace adapter blew up during customer GammaHealth install. Crash loop on install step 'register-image'. They hit this in staging image install 2026-03-19 18:02. Need arch + eng help. Attaching top log excerpt.
sophie-si: I saw the bundle — looks like the marketplace metadata is missing the Redwood signing header. Error shows: invalid-image-signature: missing x-rw-sign
miguel-eng: can you paste the exact log lines?
sophie-si: ```
ERROR: register-image failed
caused by: invalid-image-signature: missing header 'x-rw-sign'
stack: /srv/marketplace/install.go:213
``` 
devops-bot: Deployment event: PartnerCorp/staging/image-install v2.1.3 started 2026-03-19T18:01:57Z :information_source:
alex-arch: my first guess is signing metadata mismatch between PartnerCorp packager and marketplace ingestion. Could also be our image-verifier expecting header name 'x-rw-signature' vs 'x-rw-sign'. Can anyone check the verifier config?
olivia-implementation: PartnerCorp says they followed the marketplace CLI flow. I can reach out and get the exact bundle they uploaded. Do we need the raw tarball?
maria-ps: short-term workaround: we can push a signed copy to the customer's S3 bucket (GammaHealth) and point the installer at that location. Not ideal but buys time.
miguel-eng: quick config check from verifier: ```json
{"verifier": {"header_name": "x-rw-sign", "alg": "ed25519"}}
``` 
miguel-eng: I can add a shim to accept both header names; would be a small patch to the verifier. I need access to PartnerCorp signing key in vault or they can regenerate with the correct header.
lena-partnerships: who owns the hotfix? we should patch upstream and also do the manual push for the customer today.
alex-arch: I can review the patch. @miguel-eng if you open a PR I can do a rapid review and we can cut a 2.1.4 hotfix.
partners-bot: NOTE: Marketplace policy requires audit of any manual signed-image pushes. File a short incident ticket once manual push is done.
olivia-implementation: I'll coordinate the push with GammaHealth ops and collect the tarball from PartnerCorp. Can we meet 09:30 PST tomorrow to triage and confirm next steps? :calendar: 
lena-partnerships: 09:30 PST works. Miguel please create the PR and add test case for both headers. Also tag @alex-arch and @maria-ps. :thumbsup: 
miguel-eng: PR created: https://git.redwood/marketplace/verifier/pull/312 - includes shim + unit tests. Will start the manual push steps after the call.
lena-partnerships: thanks everyone, we'll handle customer comms after triage. Closing the loop here but keeping thread open for updates.
